note: Calumet County park on the east shore of Lake Winnebago, NW of Stockbridge. Its sites sit in four areas along about 2 km of the park road: the North End loop (N sites, N14-N18 on the lakeshore), the West End along the lakeshore (W sites, W9-W14 rated only 20 ft and W11-W14 grassy and uneven), the South End above the harbor (S sites) and the wooded Upper Park (U sites). A band of shoreline trees stands between the lakeshore sites and the water. Modern boat launch and harbor, two camping cabins. Construction blocks parts of the campground from late October 2026 to May 26, 2027 (N1-N24 and W1-W16; W11-W14 to June 16, 2027). --Claude
summary: County pages + Konect booking site confirm year-round camping (main season Apr 1-Oct 31), 2026 rates $22 basic / $26 electric / $34 E&W, $10 res fee, 2-night reservation minimum, 21-night max, 365-day window, 20/30/50-amp, water at S/N1-3 sites, 40-ft pads; count 84 -> 81. Lakeview kept (shore tree band). Partial construction closure Oct 2026-June 2027 noted.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview kept. The engine tags N14-N18 'on the lakeshore', W2-W8 'along the lakeshore' and S sites 'trees along the shoreline, above the harbor'. On Esri imagery the North End's west-side pads sit ~20-30 m from the water but behind a continuous band of shoreline trees (~44.1150,-88.3238); the West End sites likewise behind a tree line along the shore road. No pad on open ground to the water, so not lakefront.

STANDING MINIMUM: 'A camping reservation will be for a minimum of two consecutive nights' (April-December); 2 nights, not a drop rule. The 2026 rate sheet repeats '(2 night minimum for camping)'. Walk-in self-registration is available only before Memorial Day / after Labor Day.

PARTIAL CLOSURE (not a status): 'Calumet County Park will have partial campground closures beginning late October 2026 - the end of May 2027' - N1-N4 from Nov 1, N5-N24 from Nov 30, W1-W16 from Oct 25, all to May 26, 2027; W11-W14 to June 16, 2027. South End and Upper Park sites not listed as affected.
Base $22 = the basic (non-electric) Upper Park sites U8-U11, each 'Rated up to 25 ft'; electric $26 is the next step.

Pin 44.1058,-88.3257 kept: it sits between the West End sites and the harbor, central to a campground strung ~2 km along the shore (North End loop ~44.1150,-88.3225, ~1 km north; South End ~44.103,-88.3265). One park entrance and road, so not a split.
